title: Tool call
description: A tool call record that the core writes: a model call through P3 tools/call, the single write call of an approved approval, a campaign item call or a call of the built-in service/control. The core computes the target (TEN-3a); a call that no toolhost of the target took within start_by ends with error(no_executor), and for a target without a live toolhost at once with error(plugin_unavailable) (DLV-16). A call is not handed out again (DLV-1). Call lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/toolcall.md.

task.description: The task the call belongs to.

lease_no.description: Lease number of the attempt that made the read call.

tool.description: Tool name, for example logs/tail or service/control.

access.description: read for a read call, write for a write call.

args.description: Checked arguments; for a write call, the snapshot of the approval arguments.

approval_id.description: Approval number for a write call of an action; for a campaign item, the work id <approval_id>:<n> (FEN-7).

grant_id.description: Number of the service_grant audit record for a write call of service/control and of a routine pipeline (FEN-7).

reason.description: Reason for the outcome denied, error or exec_unknown from the reason registry, for example no_executor, plugin_unavailable, lease_expired, core_unavailable, held.

untrusted_output.description: Tool output is untrusted: the attempt gets untrusted_seen (INJ-13).

target.description: Call target: plugin, placement and machine from the catalog resource. The core takes the machine from the argument that the tool manifest named in target_from; a tool with target: any gets a target without host. claim(toolcall) hands the call only to a toolhost whose tenant, plugins, placement and machine recorded at enroll matched the target (TEN-3a).
